stages.name: ownership-and-inventory
stages.exit: Maintainer approves ownership, reuse map, threat boundary and no-new-package decision.

stages.name: contract-lock
stages.exit: Schemas, types, validators, fixtures, artifacts and compatibility rules are locked.

stages.name: pure-lease-and-comparison-kernel
stages.exit: Generation guard, prediction comparison and capsule validation pass without CLI globals.

stages.name: explicit-prediction-mvp
stages.exit: Begin, predict, status, verify, explain and abort pass JSON and process integration tests.

stages.name: decisions-and-effect-integration
stages.exit: All effects and resume behavior use one Decisions transaction and ledger.

stages.name: semantic-concurrency
stages.exit: Proof-backed overlap and honest unknown/disjoint semantics pass multi-change fixtures.

stages.name: consumer-integration
stages.exit: CLI, CI, MCP and extension consume one capsule contract without semantic forks.

stages.name: enterprise-hardening
stages.exit: Cross-platform, adversarial, crash, concurrency, scale, privacy and release gates pass.

prohibitedShortcuts: new transaction or graph truth owner
fidelity score as commit or release authority
automatic command execution from capability metadata
semantic disjointness inferred from missing graph coverage
